2.keywords: junior engineer terminated prod EC2; only architects may stop/terminate (Select TWO)
2.trap: MFA is an extra login factor — it does not prevent an authorized user from terminating
2.rule: Prevent destructive actions → remove the permission or tag-based IAM Deny. MFA ≠ authorization.

15.keywords: CloudFormation 3-tier, DynamoDB, no exposed API credentials
15.trap: Storing the role ARN in Parameter Store adds nothing — the instance profile already binds the role
15.rule: EC2 → AWS service access = IAM role via instance profile. Nothing else needed.

26.keywords: 🔁 CloudFormation; DB password rotated every 60 days; MOST secure
26.trap: Ref on a Secrets Manager secret returns its ARN, not the password; UserData exposes it
26.rule: Secret into a CFN property → dynamic reference {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}; app reads Secrets Manager at runtime.

28.keywords: portal authenticates against on-prem LDAP; per-user S3 buckets (Select TWO)
28.trap: Picked D (right) + E: Direct Connect Gateway / Transit VPC is networking, not authentication
28.rule: LDAP → custom identity broker → STS (GetFederationToken / AssumeRole) → temporary credentials.

31.keywords: on-prem users already signed in to corporate SAML IdP; no separate IAM users
31.trap: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity is for web identity providers (Google, Facebook), not SAML
31.rule: Corporate SAML IdP → IAM Identity Center / AssumeRoleWithSAML. Social login → WebIdentity / Cognito.

41.keywords: third-party account in another Organization; least privilege via API/CLI
41.trap: Role + AssumeRole works but without External ID is open to the confused-deputy problem
41.rule: Third party assumes your role → trust policy with sts:ExternalId condition.

62.keywords: admins in management account must stop/terminate resources in Dev and Test accounts
62.trap: Permissions are not inherited from the management account; the role must carry its own admin policy
62.rule: Cross-account role lives in the TARGET account (Dev/Test) with its own permissions and trusts the management account.

66.keywords: 🔁 only the cybersecurity team may access the ACM certificate; DevOps manages EC2
66.trap: An SCP never grants access to a team — it only limits what IAM can allow in an account
66.rule: Grant/limit access for a team → IAM policy. SCP = account-level guardrail. Terminate SSL on the ELB.

75.keywords: 🔁 only the owning business unit may terminate its resources in shared prod account
75.trap: 'SCP that allows access' is never correct — SCPs only filter permissions
75.rule: Resource-level terminate permission → IAM role in prod account (tag/owner conditions) assumed cross-account by the OU's accounts.

1.keywords: ALB + 2 EC2; add HTTPS; most cost-effective and easiest
1.trap: Private certificate needs ACM Private CA → monthly fee
1.rule: Public site on ALB/CloudFront/API GW → free public ACM certificate. Cannot export ACM public certs to EC2.

37.keywords: L3/L4 DDoS notification + SQLi/XSS protection (Select TWO)
37.trap: Picked B (right) + A: CloudFront cache hit ratio does not block L7 attacks
37.rule: L3/L4 DDoS + alerts → Shield Advanced; SQLi/XSS → WAF.

44.keywords: only one specific client may access files; S3 behind CloudFront (Select TWO)
44.trap: Picked A (right) + D: OAC forces CloudFront path but anyone with the CloudFront URL still gets in
44.rule: Restrict to a specific client → signed URLs (CloudFront or S3 pre-signed) + block direct S3 access.

49.trap: 'You manage KMS keys' describes SSE-KMS, not SSE-S3
49.rule: SSE-S3: unique key per object, encrypted by AWS-managed rotated root key. SSE-KMS: your KMS key. SSE-C: you supply key.

7.keywords: Oracle RAC; automate OS patching + scheduled backups; least effort
7.trap: RDS (and Aurora) do not support Oracle RAC
7.rule: Oracle RAC → EC2 + Data Lifecycle Manager snapshots + SSM Patch Manager.

9.keywords: RTO 5 minutes, RPO 1 hour, ≥250 miles away, minimal cost
9.trap: Pilot light needs CloudFormation to build web/app tiers after disaster → exceeds 5 min
9.rule: RTO hours → backup/restore; tens of min → pilot light; minutes → warm standby; ~0 → multi-site.

14.keywords: RTO < 2h, RPO 10 min, disaster resilient (Select TWO)
14.trap: Picked D (right) + B: synchronous Multi-AZ replication is HA, not a backup and not Region-safe
14.rule: Multi-AZ = availability. DR = backups + logs (or replica) in another Region.

23.keywords: 1,000 TB on one mount; POSIX block storage; users read portions during backup
23.trap: Stored volumes keep full data on-prem (max 512 TB per TD)
23.rule: Data too large for on-prem, hot subset local → Volume Gateway cached volumes. Full local low-latency copy → stored volumes.

45.keywords: DR with best RTO; static content on Storage Gateway volume
45.trap: Running Storage Gateway on EC2 and attaching via iSCSI adds a layer; restoring to EBS is faster
45.rule: Recover Volume Gateway data in AWS → restore its snapshot to an EBS volume and attach.

68.keywords: Oracle; stay available on DB failure; writes 24/7
68.trap: RMAN is backup (and not user-run on RDS); read replicas can't take writes; RAC unsupported on RDS
68.rule: DB high availability with continuous writes → RDS Multi-AZ.

17.keywords: improve availability and load balancing of web tier (Select TWO)
17.trap: Picked B (right) + C: CloudFront origin cannot be a private IP address
17.rule: ALB behind Route 53 ALIAS record; Route 53 multivalue answer = DNS-level health-checked load balancing.

18.keywords: allow only package-update URLs outbound; deny all else
18.trap: NACLs and security groups filter IP/port, never URLs
18.rule: URL/domain-based egress filtering → forward web proxy (or AWS Network Firewall).

27.keywords: PrivateLink → NLB → EC2 logging service; clients can't submit logs (Select TWO)
27.trap: Picked D (right) + E: instance SG must allow the NLB, not the clients' IP block
27.rule: Endpoint → NLB → instances: open SGs and NACLs hop by hop (NLB SG from endpoint subnet; instance SG from NLB).

34.keywords: thousands of accounts; central controlled egress; accounts edit own route tables
34.trap: Transit VPC + VPN doesn't scale; peering limits; shared VPC participants can't edit route tables
34.rule: Central egress/inspection at scale → shared Transit Gateway + GWLB-fronted firewalls in a central VPC.

3.keywords: blog entries updated in first 3 months, quiet after 6; CloudFront load time
3.trap: Price-class split distributions don't improve load time
3.rule: Content with age-dependent change rate → partition the origin (by month) so cache behaviors/TTLs differ.

24.keywords: 500 IoT sensors every 10s; enrich; in S3 within 20 min; most cost-effective
24.trap: Step Functions per data point = expensive + complex. (You answered this same question correctly in the chapter drill — a regression, not a repeat miss.)
24.rule: Stream → transform → S3 with minutes of latency → IoT rule → Data Firehose + Lambda transform (buffered).

32.keywords: SageMaker model at factory; works without internet; call on-prem Linux API
32.trap: SageMaker Edge Manager on cameras doesn't provide the local server runtime to call the API
32.rule: Offline edge ML inference on a local server → IoT Greengrass (+ Greengrass components).

38.keywords: replace email order workflow; serverless; least overhead
38.trap: Lambda polling SQS every 5 min + Pinpoint doesn't track order state
38.rule: Multi-step workflow with state → Step Functions + DynamoDB.

50.keywords: call recordings; automate transcription; reduce storage cost
50.trap: Amazon Translate translates text — it doesn't transcribe audio; EC2 ASG adds overhead
50.rule: Speech→text = Transcribe; text→language = Translate; text→speech = Polly.

59.keywords: Lambda must not affect other functions' concurrency; LEAST development effort
59.trap: Separate account + SQS works but is far more work
59.rule: Isolate a function's concurrency → reserved concurrency on that function.

43.keywords: DB to RDS + app to Elastic Beanstalk; most cost-effective strategy
43.rule: Move to managed platforms (RDS, Beanstalk) without code rewrite → Replatform.

56.keywords: versioning enabled after 4 files existed; later updates (Select TWO)
56.trap: Version IDs are never '1'; pre-existing objects keep null
56.rule: Objects existing before versioning → version ID null; new versions → random alphanumeric IDs.

67.keywords: infrequently accessed historical data; most cost-effective, throughput-oriented
67.rule: High IOPS → io1/io2; frequent throughput → st1; infrequent + cheapest → sc1.

5.keywords: self-service SageMaker notebooks; hide complexity; preconfigured KMS key
5.watch: Proton is for platform templates, not end-user self-service
5.rule: Governed self-service launch → Service Catalog portfolio of CloudFormation products.

19.keywords: Identity Center group; each scientist only own files; monthly access reports (Select TWO)
19.watch: Server access logs lack IAM identity detail; ⚠️ resource-level IAM conditions also decide Q75
19.rule: Per-user prefix → ${aws:PrincipalTag/...} policy; who accessed what → CloudTrail data events + Athena.

22.keywords: existing Windows AD passwords for AWS SSO
22.rule: Extend on-prem AD → AWS Managed Microsoft AD with trust relationship.

35.watch: Never call AWS to grant access
35.rule: CloudTrail + least-privilege read-only IAM identity for the auditor.

55.keywords: millions of mobile users; most secure S3 access
55.watch: Never embed long-term access keys in an app
55.rule: Mobile clients → temporary STS credentials (AssumeRole / Cognito).

57.keywords: SAML federation works for admin but not other users (Select THREE)
57.watch: ⚠️ Same SAML family you missed in Q31 — AssumeRoleWithSAML, not WebIdentity
57.rule: Check AssumeRoleWithSAML params, role trust policy principal = SAML provider, role mapping in assertions.

72.keywords: EC2 watermarks photos then uploads to S3 securely
72.watch: ⚠️ Q15: the instance profile alone is enough
72.rule: EC2 → S3 access = IAM role; credentials from instance metadata (not userdata).

6.keywords: viral signups; static content by device type; EC2 CPU high
6.watch: CloudFront can't natively route on full User-Agent logic
6.rule: Offload static to S3 + CloudFront; Lambda@Edge to vary content by device.

42.keywords: replay attacks on Volume Gateway iSCSI
42.watch: CHAP for NFS is wrong — CHAP applies to iSCSI

53.keywords: static (S3) + dynamic (ALB) only via CloudFront (Select TWO)
53.watch: ⚠️ Q44: OAC enforces the CloudFront path, not a specific client
53.rule: S3 origin → OAC; ALB origin → CloudFront custom header checked by WAF on the ALB.

54.keywords: SSL key always secure; logs decrypted by few users
54.rule: Key never leaves → CloudHSM with TCP LB; logs → private S3 with SSE.

65.keywords: HTTPS viewer↔CloudFront with custom domain; higher cache hit ratio (Select TWO)
65.watch: ⚠️ Q1: public ACM certs are free; import third-party certs into ACM, not S3

69.watch: Distribution ID is not a valid S3 principal
69.rule: S3 origin locked to CloudFront → Origin Access Control + bucket policy.

10.keywords: 5M readers; durable, HA, scalable news site (Select TWO)
10.rule: RDS Multi-AZ + read replicas, S3 for media, CloudFront.

11.keywords: what happens during RDS Multi-AZ failover
11.rule: Multi-AZ failover flips the DB endpoint CNAME to the standby.

13.keywords: issue tracker; steady state; OLTP; HA + fault tolerant
13.watch: Spot for a steady-state HA tier is risky
13.rule: Multi-AZ ASG + ELB + CloudFront + RDS Multi-AZ.

29.keywords: RDS down on AZ issue; photos retrievable immediately; PII discovery
29.watch: Inspector ≠ PII; Glacier Deep Archive isn't immediate
29.rule: Macie for PII; S3 IA after 1 month; RDS Multi-AZ for AZ failure.

46.rule: Separate ALB+ASG per Region + Route 53 failover routing.

48.keywords: unpredictable traffic; HA and auto scaling all tiers
48.rule: Stateless tiers + ElastiCache for state + RDS Multi-AZ with read replicas.

63.keywords: keep same IP after hardware failure; auto recovery
63.watch: Stop/start may change host and private IP behavior; reboot doesn't move hosts
63.rule: StatusCheckFailed_System alarm → EC2 recover action (keeps IPs, metadata).

39.keywords: resolve both VPC endpoints and AD domain FQDN (Select TWO)
39.watch: Inbound endpoint is for on-prem → AWS queries
39.rule: Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint + forwarding rule to AD DNS; keep AmazonProvidedDNS.

51.keywords: two subnets can't talk; track SG changes (Select TWO)
51.rule: Fix NACL + SG; AWS Config for configuration history.

52.keywords: VPC-B and VPC-C overlap; VPC-A needs one host in B
52.watch: Overlapping CIDRs need a more specific route
52.rule: Longest-prefix match: /32 route to VPC-B host, /16 to VPC-C.

61.keywords: instances in one AZ get no traffic
61.rule: ALB must have that AZ (subnet) enabled.

71.keywords: NAT instance keeps failing; least effort
71.rule: Replace NAT instances with NAT Gateway (per AZ).

8.keywords: IaC versions, stage, revert; global CDN

12.keywords: sale surge; social login; simple queue for checkout
12.watch: Lex is a chatbot, not auth
12.rule: Cognito + SQS buffer + DynamoDB behind ELB/CloudFront.

20.keywords: photo processing jobs; minimize cost; archive
20.rule: SQS depth-scaled Spot ASG workers + Glacier for archive.

21.keywords: read a CFN SNS subscription snippet
21.watch: GetAtt references an existing logical resource
21.rule: Fn::GetAtt Queue.Arn subscribes the SQS queue to the SNS topic.

30.keywords: stateless app; CPU spikes; cost over 3 years
30.watch: All-Spot for consistent response time is risky
30.rule: ASG min 5/max 30 + Reserved Instances for the baseline.

40.keywords: 50 TB scanned files + search; >3 years; cost-effective
40.watch: S3 has no native full-text search

47.keywords: on-prem Kafka → near-real-time web app; consistent network (Select THREE)
47.rule: EC2 KPL into Kinesis + Direct Connect + Lambda + WebSocket API @connections.

58.rule: Batch via Kinesis + raise DynamoDB WCU.

64.watch: ElastiCache isn't a durable metadata store
64.rule: API Gateway + Lambda + Cognito + DynamoDB + S3 presigned URLs.

73.keywords: location-based push to millions; <1 min; cheap
73.watch: Device Farm is a testing service
73.rule: SQS + workers + DynamoDB + SNS Mobile Push.

4.keywords: 150 VMs, 40 TB, 12 Mbps, 3 months; some mission-critical
4.watch: DX takes weeks and costs more
4.rule: MGN for critical VMs + offline bulk transfer + VM Import for the rest.

16.keywords: keep S3 photos and RDS summaries after stack delete
16.rule: DeletionPolicy: Retain for S3, Snapshot for RDS.

25.keywords: sync on-prem patch baselines to EC2; schedule; least effort
25.rule: Patch Manager + SSM Agent + Maintenance Windows.

33.keywords: European artists slow uploading to us-east-1 bucket
33.watch: CloudFront isn't an upload accelerator for S3 here

36.keywords: thousands of servers; outdated docs; estimate migration cost (Select THREE)
36.rule: Transform discovery + assessment jobs + CART readiness.

60.keywords: Java + MongoDB; no code change; HA
60.rule: Multi-AZ EC2 ASG + DocumentDB across AZs.
